title: Mitochondrial Staining of NK Cells by Flow Cytometry
author: Philippa R Kennedy
materials: Before diluting reagents, set up the CCCP negative controls: Add 1 μL CCCP to tubes containing 1x10^6 cells in 850 μL RPMI Incubate at 37°C (no CO 2 ) for 20 min.

Prepare staining reagents and keep on ice: TMRM: Stock (can be freeze-thawed): prepare by adding 55 μL DMSO to lyophilized TMRM Working dilution: 2 μL stock into 1 mL RPMI Mitotracker Green: Stock (can be freeze-thawed): Add 74.48 μL DMSO to tube contents to obtain 1 mM Mitotracker Green. Working dilution 100 nM in RPMI (i.e. 1:100 to get 10 μM stock; then 1:100 to get 100 nM solution)

Dilute reagents: Stock (can be freeze-thawed if necessary): Dissolve MitoSOX reagent in 13 μL DMSO to make 5 mM solution Dilute 5mM solution 1:1000 in Hanks' balanced salt solution for 5 μM solution For DMSO control, dilute DMSO 1:1000 in Hanks' balanced salt solution.

Dilute reagents: Stock (can be freeze-thawed if necessary): Dissolve MitoSOX reagent in 13 μL DMSO to make 5 mM solution Dilute 5mM solution 1:1000 in Hanks' balanced salt solution for 5 μM solution For DMSO control, dilute DMSO 1:1000 in Hanks' balanced salt solution.

steps.title: Optional Hydrogen Peroxide Stress
steps.instruction: Stress cells with hydrogen peroxide prior to harvesting for mitoSOX staining.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend 500,000 cells per condition in fresh media.
Add a titration of H2O2 (e.g., 0 μM, 10 μM, 50 μM, 100 μM).
Incubate for 1h at 37ºC.

steps.title: Prepare Cell Suspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in serum-free medium and maintain on ice.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend 1x10^6 cells in 850 μL RPMI medium (no serum) for all tubes.
Keep tubes on ice.

steps.title: Mitochondrial Staining
steps.instruction: Stain cells with TMRM and Mitotracker Green following CCCP incubation.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 μL TMRM and 50 μL Mitotracker Green (from 100nM working solution) to all tubes, including CCCP controls.
Incubate at 37°C (no CO2) for 20 min.

steps.title: First Wash
steps.instruction: Wash cells with flow buffer (1% human AB serum, 0.5 mM EDTA in PBS).

substeps.instruction: If using a 96 well plate: wash 3 times with 200 μl flow buffer.
If using a tube: wash once with 3 mL flow buffer.
Keep on ice until surface staining.

steps.title: Secondary Incubation
steps.instruction: Perform a second incubation step with working solution.

substeps.instruction: Spin down 500,000 cells per tube (400 g for 5 min) and remove supernatant.
Add 200 μL working solution to each tube.
Incubate cells at 37°C for 15 min.
If using a 96 well plate: wash 3 times with 200 μl flow buffer.
If using a tube: wash once with 3 mL flow buffer.

steps.title: Surface Marker Staining
steps.instruction: Stain cells for CD3 and CD56 markers.

substeps.instruction: Prepare stain mix per sample: 5 μL anti-CD3 BV785, 5 μL anti-CD56 PE-Cy7, and 90 μL flow buffer.
Spin down cells and complete washes, then add 100 μL stain mix per tube.
Incubate at 4°C for 15 min.
Wash twice with flow buffer.

steps.title: Viability Staining and Analysis
steps.instruction: Apply TO-PRO-3 dye and analyze via flow cytometry.

substeps.instruction: Dilute TO-PRO-3 dye (1:10,000) in flow buffer.
Add 300 μL flow buffer per tube.
Add 200 μL diluted TO-PRO-3 per tube.
Run immediately on flow cytometer (LSRII, BD Biosciences).
